ModMetaData.name: Processor Framework Hotfix 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: v0.1.3 Reservation Safe. Replaces the unsafe short-lived final Ingredient Thing cache with a live per-ThingDef ListerThings candidate index. Every FillProcessor lookup rechecks the current pawn's forbidden state, carry space, processor capacity, reservation, and reachability. Also aligns WorkGiver processor reservation admission with JobDriver_FillProcessor's real maxPawns=1 authority and adds a final JobOnThing reservation guard.
